integrity: Proof derived from formal bivariate generating series and a coefficientwise induction; finite exact rational checks are independent corroboration, not substitutes for the proof. No outside validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Uniform labeled recursive trees only; conditional first moment, not arbitrary branching tree laws or conditional full distributions. Earlier general increasing-tree generating functions might indirectly imply the result. Full text of Gołębiewski–Klimczak (2019) was inaccessible, leaving historical-priority uncertainty.
title: A sharp protection-depth barrier for conditional leaf means in random recursive trees
